label:
<think>
The compilation errors arise because jakarta.mvc 2.0.1 moved the MVC API from javax.mvc.* to jakarta.mvc.* and removed MvcContext entirely. Thus, imports for Controller and Models must be updated to jakarta.mvc.*, and any usage of MvcContext must be eliminated. To obtain the Locale, we can use JAX-RS’s HttpHeaders via @Context to read the request language/acceptable languages, which keeps the method signature unchanged and avoids reliance on the removed MvcContext. We will:
- Replace javax.mvc.Controller and javax.mvc.Models imports with jakarta.mvc.* equivalents.
- Remove the javax.mvc.MvcContext import.
- Inject javax.ws.rs.core.HttpHeaders via @Context.
- Replace mvc.getLocale() usage with logic using HttpHeaders to determine the locale, with a sensible fallback.
This keeps the rest of the code intact and compatible with the new API.
</think>
